description:
Connect an integration

Stores the credentials and settings for one third-party service and returns the new integration's identifier. The integration is created active, but connecting it does not by itself let an agent use it: it still has to be assigned to an agent or chatbot. `config` is a JSON string, not a nested object, so serialise it before sending; the keys it must contain are the ones listed under `configFields` for this type in GET /integrations/types. A `config` that contains the mask `********` anywhere is refused with 400 and error code `masked_without_stored_value`: the mask stands for a stored secret, and a new integration has none, so send the real values. Keys inside `config` that only the server writes (the connection keys and `toolPermissions`) are dropped before the integration is stored. Nothing is contacted at creation time, so a wrong credential is only noticed later: call the test endpoint afterwards to confirm the connection works. A WhatsApp integration whose phone number is already connected in an active integration of another account is refused with 409 and error code `conflict`. A Genesys Cloud integration (type `genesys_cloud`) follows its own rules.

body.description: The service to connect, a name to recognise it by, an optional description, and `config`: a JSON string holding the fields that type requires.
